question.text: The magnetic moment of the complex anion $\left[\mathrm{Cr}(\mathrm{NO})\left(\mathrm{NH}_3\right)(\mathrm{CN})_4\right]^{2-}$ is :

solution.text:
$\operatorname{In}\left[\mathrm{Cr}(\mathrm{NO})\left(\mathrm{NH}_3\right)(\mathrm{CN})_4\right]^{2-}$, $\mathrm{Cr}^{2+}\left(\mathrm{d}^4\right)$ is given as :
i.e., 2 unpaired electrons $$ \mu=\sqrt{2(2+2)}=\sqrt{8}=2.82 $$
